does: Plunges food briefly into boiling water, to clean bones, loosen skins or set the colour of green vegetables.
how: For bones, cover them with cold water, bring it to a boil, then drain them and rinse off the scum.
For vegetables, drop them into fast-boiling salted water.
Lift them out as soon as the colour brightens.
Cool them at once in iced water.

cues.text: Green vegetables turn a vivid green. Bones come out clean, with the grey scum left behind in the water.

mistakes.mistake: Leaving vegetables in until they are tender, when they were only meant to be set.
mistakes.fix: Take them out early. They are cooked again later.

variant_of.differs: The food stays in only briefly and is not cooked to the end.
